Marta (Docs): Heads-up: we're publishing a docs + SDK note about typed responses for generated outputs. New recommended pattern returns typed result shapes from SDK helpers. Draft rollout and migration below.
Ibrahim (SDK): TL;DR: SDK helper methods will add an optional generic type param in v4.1 to surface shapes (non-breaking). v5 will enforce parsing into types by default and may throw on mismatch (breaking).
Olivia (TypeTeam): We'll provide TypeScript types and JSON schema for common response shapes. Docs will include examples for schema validation and safe parsing.
Marta (Docs): Added migration examples to the PR: show pre-v4.1 untyped usage, then v4.1 typed hints, and v5 strict parsing.
Rex (QA): QA checklist: 1) examples compile with tsconfig strict 2) runtime fallback path when parsing fails 3) error messages are actionable.
ci-bot: CI: docs build started (job #563).
Ibrahim (SDK): Example snippet in PR:
```
// v4.0 (untyped)
const res = await client.generate({ prompt });
// v4.1 (typed hint)
const res = await client.generate<MyShape>({ prompt });
// v5 (strict parsing)
const res = await client.generate<MyShape>({ prompt, strictParse: true });
```
Olivia (TypeTeam): We'll publish myshape.d.ts + JSON schema in the repo. Also adding quick codemods for common patterns.
Marta (Docs): Communication plan: release notes, changelog banner, and a short "How to migrate" guide in docs. Timeline: warning deprecation in v4.1, breaking baseline in v5 (90 days after v4.1).
Rex (QA): Ran smoke tests on staging snippets: typed hints compile. Need follow-up on Node 12 environment compatibility.
Ibrahim (SDK): We'll keep runtime fallback for Node 12 but mark performance caveat. Also we'll emit a one-time deprecation warning when strictParse is not used before v5.
announce-bot: Scheduled announcement in #general after docs deploy.
Marta (Docs): Post-deploy: docs published, changelog updated, announcement queued. Closing thread; flag any late regressions here.
